exposure: Timing of first intrapartum fetal blood sampling (FBS) (<4 cm vs. ≥4 cm cervical dilation)
First FBS at <4 cm cervical dilation
First FBS at ≥4 cm cervical dilation
Intrapartum fetal blood sampling (FBS) at <4 cm cervical dilation
cohort: 591 laboring women who underwent FBS in a tertiary center between 2015 and 2017
finding: Women who had their first intrapartum fetal blood sampling at <4 cm cervical dilation were twice as likely to have a caesarean section compared to women who had their first FBS at ≥4 cm, but there was no difference in the overall rate of operative delivery or neonatal outcomes.
